breakdown.description: The inward normal pressure on the arc is replaced by a fixed vertical traction vector
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'A uniform vertical traction vector of (0, -20000) Pa is applied to the semi-circular arc boundary,' which is exactly the incorrect approach from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires treating the arc load as an inward pressure (t = -p*n, where n is the outward normal of the solid), not as a fixed vertical traction vector. The agent failed to correct this inconsistency and instead repeated the original error.
